description: Ministry of Megapolis & Western Developments - Amendment to the Gaz. Extra Ordinary No. 2129/95 of the 28.06.2019, published on Anuradhapura Urban Development Area
reasoning: This gazette is a legal/regulatory notification that rectifies a previous gazette (No. 2129/95) regarding a development plan for the Anuradhapura Urban Development Area. It involves amendments to legal terminology and the scope of the development area under the Urban Development Authority Law, No. 41 of 1978. While it mentions a minister's name and title, the primary purpose is to correct legal/regulatory content in a previous gazette notification, making it a legal/regulatory matter rather than a government personnel or structural change.
